name: Paperclip
profile: Self-hosted Paperclip in Docker Compose (authenticated mode, one server). About 10 agents run on the claude_local adapter with a Claude subscription, a few on codex_local with a ChatGPT subscription. A CEO agent hires, configures and manages the other agents; agents work with git repositories and remote MCP servers.

areas.claude_adapter: Claude Code adapter (claude_local, Claude ACP bridge, Claude auth, Claude models)
areas.codex_adapter: Codex adapter (codex_local, Codex ACP, ChatGPT sign-in)
areas.other_adapters: Other agent adapters: Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes, OpenClaw, Kimi, Grok, HTTP, process
areas.ai_connections_auth: AI accounts and connections, subscriptions, API keys, secrets, user login and permissions
areas.heartbeat_runs: Heartbeats, run scheduling, run recovery, retries, wakes, queues, liveness

areas.chat_channels: Chat integrations: Slack, Telegram, email, iMessage, agent chat
